_comment: Questions asked of the real chat pipeline by scripts/demo/generate_demo_conversations.py. Each `items` entry is an item id in the shipped bundle's manifest (bundle-v1). A question is asked in its own conversation, followed by its follow-ups. At least half of the conversations are cross-file. The privacy-redaction item id is reserved for the scripted clip that the owner still has to record (bundle-v1/privacy-demo/SCRIPT.md); until it exists in the manifest, the generator reports it as missing. Questions that name specifics (dates, topics) are drawn from the items' opening captions (YouTube auto-captions) or page descriptions and must be rechecked against the transcripts once they exist.

conversations.title: What do the space and Moon reports explain?
questions: Summarize each of the three space reports in two sentences.
What caused the Ingenuity Mars helicopter to crash, and what does NASA say the team learned from the flights?
Which report describes spacecraft that have entered interstellar space, and what are they studying there?
What did the Moon water study find, and which instrument provided the data?

conversations.title: Which inventors and pioneers do these features profile?
questions: Give a one-line summary of each profile.
What did the Wright brothers achieve on December 17th, 1903, and how long was the first flight?
How does the Robert Goddard feature compare his rocket work to the first airplane flight?
What is Thomas Edison remembered for, and how did he learn as a child?

conversations.title: What do the Yellowstone and Pearl S. Buck reports cover?
questions: Summarize the Yellowstone report and the Pearl S. Buck report in two sentences each.
What makes Yellowstone unusual according to the report, and how many geysers does it have?
What is The Good Earth about, and why was Pearl Buck the first American woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature?

conversations.title: What English expressions do the language features explain?
questions: Which expressions does each feature explain?
How does the butterfly effect feature explain a chain reaction, and what related expression does it mention?
Across all the English-language reports in the News collection, which ones are about science or invention and which are about language?

conversations.title: How do NASA's public meetings begin?

What is the NASA Advisory Council described as, and what administrative announcements precede the agenda?
Compare the town hall for the Exploration Systems directorate with the Science directorate's peer-review town hall: what does each say it will cover?
